source_title: Dravid, Sehwag named in India squad for U19 Asia Cup
source_excerpt: Sons of former India cricketers Rahul Dravid and Virender Sehwag, Anvay Dravid and Aaryavir Sehwag, have been named in India's squad for the upcoming ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup.The tournament will be held in Muscat, Oman, from November 5 to 14. The 17-year-old Anvay and 19-year-old Aaryavir earned their places after impressive performances in the recently concluded Vinoo Mankad Trophy.Both youngsters have been among the top performers in the domestic U19 competition and will now get an opportunity to represent India at the continental tournament.Anvay, Aaryavir impress with the batAnvay, who represents Karnataka, has been in excellent form. He played a stunning knock of 151 off just 100 balls against Gujarat earlier this month, helping his team chase down a target of more than 300 runs.He had also impressed during India's Youth ODI tour of Sri Lanka in July, scoring 87 off 67 balls against the hosts at Hambantota.Aaryavir, meanwhile, has also made a strong impression with his batting. Representing Delhi, he smashed 173 off 143 balls against Chandigarh in the Vinoo Mankad Trophy at Vizianagaram.The two youngsters will now look to carry their good form into the U19 Asia Cup.India placed in Group A with PakistanIndia will be led by Lakshya Raichandani in the tournament. They have been placed in Group A alongside Pakistan, Nepal and the UAE.Group B features Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Afghanistan and Malaysia.The top two teams from each group will qualify for the semi-finals.India's U19 Asia Cup squadLakshya Raichandani (C), Aaryavir Sehwag, V.K. Vineeth, Yashbardhan Singh Chauhan (VC), Kushagra Ojha, Arjun Rajput, Manal Chauhan, Anvay Dravid (WK), Rajat Baghel (WK), V. Yashveer, Aryan Savsani, Mohit Ulva, Kavya Patel, Shavin Vinod and Ishan Sood.India's U19 Asia Cup scheduleMatchDateVenueIndia vs NepalNovember 6MuscatIndia vs PakistanNovember 8MuscatIndia vs UAENovember 10MuscatIndia will begin their campaign against Nepal on November 6 before taking on arch-rivals Pakistan two days later.
